notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857836/850cee61a845ab9b69192eba3eeedaf59a2ff803.png[/img]
Hi everyone! Thank you so much for the warm welcome at the launch of SherloCAT Holmes Nonogam! As you can see, I’m still looking for Sherlock.

[b]We received a lot of feedback and are doing our best to address everyone’s concerns. Here’s the list of adjustments in this update:[/b]

[list]
[*] Minor adjustments to the resolution of 3 puzzles that were impossible to solve without a hint.
[*] 2 new translations: French and German.
[*] We added 1 more life on the medium level and 3 more lives on the hard level! We hope that will be enough.
[*] A bit more of the story about the search for SherloCAT in each location. You unlock this by solving the first 5 puzzles.
[*] We also added SherloCAT to the gameplay, so now you can see him panicking when you only have one life left.
[*] We introduced a touch mode; now you can choose to mark just the square or the ball, regardless of the key you select.
[*] Minor bug fixes in the sound.
[*] In the option to disable autocomplete, it also removes the strike-through on the number. It only strikes the number if you mark it with the right mouse button on the left and right side of the block.
[*] Did you think you made a bad selection with the mouse but it’s still selected? You can now cancel the selection with the reverse button.
[/list]
